subject: 121 Riverside Avenue Site Plan Review
overview: The Community Development Board conducted a site plan review for the Medford Housing Authority's comprehensive modernization of the Saltonstall building at 121 Riverside Ave. The board approved the site plan with conditions, including requirements around sustainability certifications, trash receptacles, and compliance with department review letters.

items.title: Site Plan Review: 121 Riverside Avenue (Saltonstall Building)
items.summary: Approved with conditions a site plan review application by the Medford Housing Authority to modernize the Saltonstall building, increasing units from 200 to 222, overhauling the building envelope, reconfiguring parking, and relocating the adjacent bocce courts.

items.title: Approval of Minutes: October 26, 2022
items.summary: Voted to continue review and approval of the October 26, 2022 meeting minutes to the next regular meeting.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Upcoming Schedule
items.summary: Discussed meeting scheduling for December and 2023, reminded members regarding state conflict of interest training, and received an update from the planning director on efforts to digitize the city's zoning map and hire consultants for comprehensive zoning recodification.
